evals.prompt: Score this task: fix a typo in one button label in the settings page.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the complexity-assessor only when invoked by the pipeline and returns normalized score, six-part breakdown, routing, and rationale. Low scores route to writing-plans.

assertions.name: normalized-output
assertions.description: The response returns score, breakdown, routing, and rationale.

assertions.name: low-score-routing
assertions.description: The response routes simple work to writing-plans.

evals.prompt: Score this task: integrate a new external identity provider across backend, UI, configuration, and deployment.
evals.expected_output: Uses the complexity-assessor and returns a higher score with routing to brainstorming due to integration scope and risk.

assertions.name: risk-reflected
assertions.description: The response reflects provider integration and cross-system risk in the score.

assertions.name: brainstorming-route
assertions.description: The response routes medium or high complexity work through brainstorming.

evals.prompt: Score this task: rewrite the entire authentication, authorization, billing, and deployment stack from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Returns split-required or clearly halts for decomposition when the assessor flags work too large for one run.

assertions.name: split-required
assertions.description: The response identifies the task as needing decomposition.

assertions.name: does-not-downplay
assertions.description: The response does not route a full-system rewrite as a normal small or medium task.
